trade_offs: Each capability runs one non-interactive bash command (20 s maximum, 64 KiB per stream), not an interactive PTY, to stay inside the 30 s RPC exchange.
Hold time is attempt time: admission adds one grace to the reservation and to the unit RuntimeMaxSec (plus 2 s) only when a hold is possible.
Capacity pressure is detected from denied admissions: the denied caller retries once the held VM is destroyed.
The debug_issue response, including the token, is retained by request replay protection in the private service database; it is single-use and short-lived.
Guest images built before this change close the session after the run, so a debug command fails and the hold ends as guest_lost.
